# -- 基础产出 --
bca_job_bureaucrat_unity_base = {
    base = 3.0
    modifier = {
        add = -1.0
        OR = {
            bureaucrat_is_death_priest = yes
            bureaucrat_is_cremator = yes
        }
    }
    modifier = {
        add = -1.0
        bureaucrat_is_haruspex = yes
    }
    modifier = {
        add = -1.0
        colony = {
            bureaucrat_is_low_tech = yes
        }
    }
    modifier = {
        add = -2.0
        colony = {
            bureaucrat_is_sacred_path_specialist = yes
        }
    }
    modifier = {
        add = -1.0
        colony = {
            bureaucrat_is_low_tech_manager = yes
        }
    }
    modifier = {
        add = -1.0
        colony = {
            bureaucrat_is_low_tech_priest = yes
        }
    }
    modifier = {
        add = -1.0
        colony = {
            bureaucrat_is_numistic_priest = yes
        }
    }
}

# -- 乘数链 --
bca_job_bureaucrat_unity_mult = {
    base = 1

# -- 基础产出 --
bca_job_turtle_miner_gestalt_food_base = {
    base = 2.0
    modifier = {
        add = 1.0
        colony = {
            has_active_building = building_food_processing_facility
        }
    }
    modifier = {
        add = 2.0
        colony = {
            has_active_building = building_food_processing_center
        }
    }
}

# -- 乘数链 --
bca_job_turtle_miner_gestalt_food_mult = {
    base = 1
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_productive_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_complex_and_simple_drone_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_simple_drone_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_jobs_food_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_miners_produces_mult
    add = modifier:planet_miners_food_produces_mult
}

# -- 加数链 --
bca_job_turtle_miner_gestalt_food_add = {
    add = modifier:planet_miners_food_produces_add
}

# -- 每 1 workforce 产出 --
bca_job_turtle_miner_gestalt_food_per_worker = {
    add = value:bca_job_turtle_miner_gestalt_food_base
    add = value:bca_job_turtle_miner_gestalt_food_add
    mult = value:bca_job_turtle_miner_gestalt_food_mult
    divide = 100
}
